Monolithic Torment Forever.title: Memorial Reissue CDs
Monolithic Torment Forever.about:
A few years ago, my dear friend and major inspiration and noise mentor, Emily Aideen, took her own life.
Grief never ends, it just evolves. Sometimes, it needs an outlet.
I've decided to reissue a bunch of Emily's bandcamp-only releases on CD. ALL FUNDS WILL BE DONATED. Donations are split between Emily's family and the 988 Suicide Hotline.

Monolithic Torment Forever.title: Monolithic Torment Forever
Monolithic Torment Forever.about:
Emily Aideen was the queen of harsh noise wall. She was an inspiration and a friend to so many people. We wanted to honor her memory with these songs, collected together in this tribute compilation.
There is so much to be said for the loved ones we lose, but I'm finding it difficult to pick out the right words for Emily. I wanted to help create something that brings people together and helps them remember Emily. I can't find the words, so I'll let these tracks talk for themselves. Everyone on this compilation loved Emily and was inspired by Emily and her art. This massive 108 song, 30+ hour compilation would never have come together without Emily and her passion for her craft. This is something special, about someone special. May her memory live on forever, in our hearts, in our minds, and in our art.
Rest In Peace
Emily Aideen
May 2nd, 1984 - June 11th, 2022

released July 4, 2022
All proceeds from digital and physical sales will go towards Emily's family, and then towards the national suicide hotline. (1-800-273-8255)
This compilation was organized by Alyx Ill, who wouldn't be making noise wall if it wasn't for Emily. Find more of her work at  yotzeretsheydim.bandcamp.com
